rejectMechanism: account-state precondition (dreggRoot) pinned the retired root
rejectResult: included and PROCESSED by the network; fee consumed, nonce bumped, zkApp state unchanged
splicedProofOutcome: rejected by the daemon [verification]: ["{\"statusCode\":200,\"statusText\":\"Couldn't send zkApp command: Stale verification key detected. Please make sure that deployed verification key reflects latest zkApp changes.\"}"]
splicedProofReading: the same proof bytes were REFUSED on a different account update and APPLIED on their own; the only variable was the statement, so the refusal is a verification failure, not a decode failure
tamperedWitness: unprovable (constraint system unsatisfiable); no tx exists
splicedProofDaemonWording: o1js REWRITES this verdict before it is visible. dist/node/lib/mina/v1/errors.js replaces the daemon's literal '(invalid (Invalid_proof "In progress"))' with 'Stale verification key detected...'. The underlying verdict is Invalid_proof - the network saying this proof does not verify - and the stale-VK guess is wrong here: the control tx below was accepted against the SAME verification key with the SAME proof bytes.
blockProvenance: Block heights read back from bestChain after the run; the script itself records hashes only. Re-checkable with: npm run devnet:tx-status -- <hash>
splicedProofNote: The spliced command never entered a block (refused at admission), so it has no hash. R2a likewise.
